description:
OXP is an unofficial companion for Odoo Experience at Brussels Expo. It is not affiliated with Odoo S.A.

Browse the public agenda, save the talks you care about, and get a reminder before they start. Find rooms on the hall maps and look up partners on the expo floor.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Today — see what’s happening, what’s next, and the talks you saved
• Schedule — list or agenda view across conference days, with search and topic filters
• Map — hall floor plans, rooms, and a campus map for Brussels Expo
• Expo — partners and startups from the public exhibitor list
• Saved — your lineup, with optional local reminders

The catalog ships with the app. Favorites and reminder settings stay on your device. Location is optional and only used to show you on the campus map.

Odoo Experience 2026 · 22–26 September · Brussels Expo
promotionalText: Unofficial Odoo Experience guide: talks, halls, and booths at Brussels Expo.
